name: Andaz Lisbon
positioning: Andaz hotel at Praça do Comércio in Lisbon's Baixa district, in buildings that were once home to residences and financial institutions
best_for: Travelers who want a central Baixa base at Praça do Comércio, with Chiado and Bairro Alto a short stroll away
Guests who want a room overlooking Praça do Comércio or São Jorge Castle

facts.text: The hotel is positioned at Praça do Comércio, in the heart of Lisbon.
The hotel is in Lisbon's Baixa district, an area known for its squares, historic landmarks and shopping streets.
The Chiado and Bairro Alto neighborhoods are a short stroll from the hotel.
The hotel's buildings were once home to a mix of residences and financial institutions.
The rooms and suites combine modern design with local character.
The King Bed Premium rooms have two or more windows that bring in natural light.
The Presidential Suite has a 4.7-metre ceiling.
Luzzi is the hotel's rooftop restaurant and terrace lounge.
Luzzi serves modern Lusitanian cuisine, with a menu reflecting Portugal's influence from Goa and Macau to São Paulo.
The hotel has a fitness center.
Pets are welcome, with a bed, bowl and treats provided.

highlights.text: The Landmark View Premium rooms overlook Praça do Comércio or São Jorge Castle.
The hotel's buildings were once home to a mix of residences and financial institutions.
The Rua Augusta View rooms overlook the Rua Augusta pedestrian street.
The Presidential Suite has a separate bedroom and a living room with a dining area.

considerations.text: Guest parking is at the Praça do Município Parking, about three minutes away by car.
Height, breed and weight restrictions apply to pets.
WhataHotel notes a higher price point reflecting the luxury positioning.
